title: Platform Chess
description:
In Platform Chess, making the right move is only the beginning.

Move your pieces across a traditional chessboard, then fight for control in fast platform-combat battles. Pawns, knights, bishops, rooks, queens, and kings each have their own movement, attacks, abilities, and playstyle based on their role in chess.

Winning takes more than memorizing openings. You must outthink your opponent on the board and outplay them in the arena.

• Chess

• Platform-fighting battles

• Six distinct fighter types

• Unique abilities for every piece

• Local two-player matches

• Server hosting through steam

• Single-player matches against the computer

Protect your king, control the board, and prove that every move matters.
description_short: Platform Chess combines classic board strategy with platform-fighting combat. Plan your moves, battle for captures, and master the unique abilities of every chess piece in local matches or against the computer.
